The [[Eidolon]] is an [[elementalist]] [[boss]] which plays an important but passive role in the [[Prophecies]] [[storyline]]. The players seek it for its [[Spectral Essence]], a material required for the [[Ancient Seer]] to [[infusion|infuse]] armor.

It can be found in three missions: [[Iron Mines of Moladune]], [[Ring of Fire]] and [[Abaddon's Mouth]]. There is also another [[NPC]] similar to Eidolon and its function, but called [[Ice Beast]], in [[Mineral Springs]] explorable area.
